smoke.result:
Git/workflow extension for recur. Keeps recur pure hierarchy semantics.

Usage: recur-git.exe <COMMAND>

Commands:
  checkpoint    Capture a parallel-lane checkpoint entry (git + active todo leaves)
  test-receipt  Run one bounded test target and write an immutable eventness receipt
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Stateful companion for bounded Recur Lang coordination

Usage: recur-lang.exe <COMMAND>

Commands:
  warp  Plan or confirm one declared E0 -> dE -> Ef transition
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Save artifact versions and update Recur version manifests

Usage: recur-version.exe [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  next  Print the next version token for a current artifact
  save  Save a current artifact snapshot and update its manifest
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -d, --dir <DIR>  Project root or directory containing `.recur/` [default: .]
      --json       Output as JSON
  -h, --help       Print help
  -V, --version    Print version

Write confirmed Warp Slice completion layers

Usage: recur-warp.exe [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  llm       Discover app prompts and prepare evidence; does not call an LLM
  init      Install missing editable defaults. Removal policy is configuration only: no removal command or Git snapshot/ref enforcement is provided
  create    Preview a configured bubble map; --confirm creates it without overwriting
  receipt   Preview a policy-aware lifecycle receipt; --confirm records a declaration
  complete  Plan or persist one accepted Slice completion layer
  evolve    Plan or persist a superseding Warp bubble after an explosion
  collapse  Plan or execute archival of unambiguous completed eventness
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -d, --dir <DIR>  Project root containing the Warp bubble map [default: .]
      --json       Output as JSON
      --sep <SEP>  Explicit hierarchy separator for prompt context queries
  -h, --help       Print help
  -V, --version    Print version

Watch vault or project files for matching hierarchical events

Usage: recur-watch.exe [OPTIONS] --filter <PATTERN>

Options:
      --id <ID>                     Watch runtime id used for .recur/watch status records
      --filter <PATTERN>            Hierarchical pattern to subscribe to
  -d, --dir <DIR>                   Root directory to watch [default: .]
      --format <FORMAT>             Output format: oneline or json [default: oneline]
      --poll-framing <SECONDS>      Poll interval in integer seconds; omit for filesystem-event streaming mode
      --color                       Use color in output
      --json                        Output as JSON
      --sep <CHAR>                  Hierarchy separator character (default: '.') Use '_' for Rust modules, '-' for kebab-case, ':' for namespaces May be provided multiple times for multi-separator queries
      --sep-replace-default <CHAR>  When using multiple separators, normalize output to this separator
      --show-sep                    Show which separator was used for each file (e.g., [.] or [_])
  -h, --help                        Print help
  -V, --version                     Print version

Hierarchy-aware code search for modern codebases

Named in tribute to Dennis Ritchie's early work on recursive program structure.

Usage: recur.exe [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  prompt       Discover capability prompts or prepare bounded evidence for an intent
  files        Find files matching a recursive hierarchical pattern
  find         Search for text within hierarchically-scoped files (recursive)
  tree         Show recursive hierarchy tree for files
  related      Find files related to (siblings of) a given file in the hierarchy
  children     Find files that are children of a hierarchy (recursive)
  id           Search for hierarchical identifiers in file content (recursive)
  stats        Show statistics for a hierarchy (files, lines, depth)
  callers      Find all places where a function/method is called
  callees      Find all functions/methods that a given function calls (callees/dependencies)
  trace        Multi-level call graph visualization (trace execution/usage paths)
  trace-stats  Analyze call graph complexity statistics
  merge        Merge hierarchical results from multiple naming conventions
  trait        Manage trait configuration in .recur/config.toml
  init         Initialize or analyze project-local `.recur/config.toml`
  lane         Scaffold or list named lane sub-roots
  reveal       Reveal lane-local rehydration capsules (`*.recur.md`)
  psyche       Inspect `.recur` agent vault structure for missing or inconsistent files
  watch        Inspect watcher state written by `recur-watch`
  version      Inspect artifact version policy, manifests, and preserved history
  capability   Inspect root `.recur-*` capability cards
  warp         List remaining Warp bubbles, or query eventness and residual pressure
  lang         Pure, bounded Recur Lang discovery, contract views and static checks
  flatten      Flatten structured files (XML, JSON, TOML, YAML, CSV) into hierarchical dot-paths
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --color                       Use color in output
      --json                        Output as JSON
      --sep <CHAR>                  Hierarchy separator character (default: '.') Use '_' for Rust modules, '-' for kebab-case, ':' for namespaces May be provided multiple times for multi-separator queries
      --sep-replace-default <CHAR>  When using multiple separators, normalize output to this separator
      --show-sep                    Show which separator was used for each file (e.g., [.] or [_])
  -h, --help                        Print help
  -V, --version                     Print version

A quiet nod to Dennis Ritchie's 1968 thesis on recursive functions and program structure.

Homepage: https://github.com/userlevelup/recur

Additional commands:
  recur trace-id --help
  recur reveal --help
  recur capability --help
  recur version --help

Pure, bounded Recur Lang discovery, contract views and static checks

Usage: recur.exe lang [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list    Discover .recur sources under the read root, including unsupported inputs
  show    Inspect one scoped function or lane; bindings are never executed
  report  Explain header, body and footer; filter recorded Eventness without ranking
  check   Check the supported fragment: exit 0 sound, 1 findings, 2 invalid input
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -d, --dir <DIR>                   Read root; relative sources resolve here and cannot escape it [default: .]
      --color                       Use color in output
      --json                        Output as JSON
      --sep <CHAR>                  Hierarchy separator character (default: '.') Use '_' for Rust modules, '-' for kebab-case, ':' for namespaces May be provided multiple times for multi-separator queries
      --sep-replace-default <CHAR>  When using multiple separators, normalize output to this separator
      --show-sep                    Show which separator was used for each file (e.g., [.] or [_])
  -h, --help                        Print help
